title: TaskHarbor Development Tracker
summary: Synthetic live preview of the evolving GitHub feature branch. A feature is complete only after unit and browser acceptance tests.

milestones.name: Light & dark themes
milestones.detail: Desktop/mobile rendered checks, preference persistence, pages and controls

milestones.name: Find Work vs My Tasks
milestones.detail: Role-scoped cards, filters, completed browser checks

milestones.name: Admin payouts & member balances
milestones.detail: Read-only aggregate SQL, role checks, synthetic DB tests

milestones.name: Structured submission forms
milestones.detail: AI, transcription, annotation and project evidence forms; specialist tools still absent

milestones.name: Multi-worker project slots
milestones.detail: Existing tasks single-assignment; needs capacity and work unit accounting

milestones.name: Worker qualifications
milestones.detail: Skills metadata exists; server-side eligibility tests remain

milestones.name: Transcription player & annotation canvas
milestones.detail: Real workspaces, media privacy, autosave and review QA

milestones.name: Client/business portal
milestones.detail: Projects, funding verification, deliverable acceptance and permissions

milestones.name: Authorized external partners
milestones.detail: Requires partner acceptance, callback verification and reconciliation

milestones.name: Production release
milestones.detail: Backups, AppSail revision verification, staging security tests and approved migration

notes: The preview intentionally uses synthetic worker accounts, sample tasks and sample balances only.
Actions here cannot trigger a real withdrawal, worker payout, third-party integration or database write.
GitHub pushes to the preview source branch trigger preview redeployments when Railway deployment is connected.
